info.title: B2B Distribution Platform — API Catalog
info.source: DOC-11B v1.0 + DOC-07 AD-FSD + DOC-08 IAM + DOC-12A/12B/12E extras

conventions.money: Integer minor currency units (BR-AD-18). 12000 means 12000, not 120.00.
conventions.idempotency: X-Idempotency-Key required on writes (BR-AD-24 / ADR-05). Replay 24h. Same key + different body → 409 idempotency_key_conflict.

standard_headers.X-Device-Id: UUID — required for apps and warehouse
standard_headers.X-App-Version: 1.4.2 (142) — required for apps; 426 upgrade_required if stale
standard_headers.X-Client: retailer-android | retailer-ios | rep-android | rep-ios | channel-web | warehouse-desktop | platform-web

endpoints.name: Request OTP
endpoints.description: purpose: register|login. Rate: 3/hour per phone, 10/hour per device, 30/hour per IP (REQ-CM-055). Phone E.164 Syrian mobile.

endpoints.name: Verify OTP
endpoints.description: 5 attempts per otp_id. New user returns is_new_user=true without a full profile.

endpoints.name: Resend OTP
endpoints.description: prefer_channel: whatsapp|sms. Falls back to SMS if WhatsApp fails.

endpoints.name: App session bootstrap
endpoints.description: Called on every launch (REQ-CM-004). Distinguishes new vs returning users (TB-RT-011). requires_legal_accept blocks usage until consent (DOC-12E TB-AD-081). user.avatar is always null until media upload. Reps also receive commercial_limits, duty {on_duty, tracking_enabled}, status (profile: pending_review|active|rejected|disabled), and channel {id, name|null} (BF-06).

endpoints.name: App logout
endpoints.description: Client must wipe local data (REQ-CM-056).

endpoints.name: Public reference snapshot
endpoints.description: Registration screens cache this locally and refresh by cursor (REQ-AD-032, REQ-CM-016).

endpoints.name: App config / force-update
endpoints.description: Called on every app launch (REQ-AD-073, 074). Stale X-App-Version → 426.

endpoints.name: Complete retailer registration
endpoints.description: No email field ever (REQ-RT-003). Zone must belong to governorate.

endpoints.name: Retailer home
endpoints.description: Single round-trip for the header (TB-RT-020). No five calls.

endpoints.name: Categories
endpoints.description: Filtered by the retailer activity type and selected categories.

endpoints.name: Browse products
endpoints.description: availability is in_stock|low|out_of_stock — never a stock number (REQ-IN-06, BR-02, BR-14). price.label is server-composed.

endpoints.name: Product detail
endpoints.description: supply_channel is omitted while related orders are pending (REQ-IN-06).

endpoints.name: List shortages
endpoints.description: DOC-12A TB-RT-031. Synced via EP-SY-002.

endpoints.name: Add shortage
endpoints.description: DOC-12A TB-RT-031.

endpoints.name: Remove shortage
endpoints.description: DOC-12A TB-RT-031.

endpoints.name: Server price quote
endpoints.description: Single source of truth (REQ-IN-07). Precedence stop-at-first-match (most specific wins; lists do not stack): retailer_price ← group_list ← zone_list ← qty_tier ← base_price. Clients must not send prices.

endpoints.name: Browse offers
endpoints.description: company (channel identity) stays hidden until an order is confirmed (REQ-IN-06).

endpoints.name: Offer detail
endpoints.description: Re-validate via quote before submit (TB-RT-043).

endpoints.name: Get cart
endpoints.description: supply_channel_ref is anonymous (ch_a1) until submit (REQ-IN-06 / TB-RT-050).

endpoints.name: Add cart line
endpoints.description: source: browse|shortage|favorite|reorder|offer. Full cart is recalculated.

endpoints.name: Update cart qty
endpoints.description: Offers that lose their condition are listed in removed_offers (BR-20).

endpoints.name: Remove cart line
endpoints.description: Removing a line that belongs to an offer removes the whole offer (BR-08).

endpoints.name: Submit cart
endpoints.description: If offline_created=true the order is always accepted, then repriced; repricing_diff is shown (REQ-CM-018). Split is server-side (REQ-IN-08).

endpoints.name: List orders
endpoints.description: filter[status]: all|active|pending|processing|delivered|cancelled. supply_channel is null until confirmed (REQ-IN-06).

endpoints.name: Order detail
endpoints.description: rep{name,phone} only when status is on_the_way (BR-03).

endpoints.name: Cancel order
endpoints.description: 409 unless status is pending (BR-06).

endpoints.name: Reorder
endpoints.description: Returns a cart repriced at today's prices.

endpoints.name: Track order
endpoints.description: Rep identity only at on_the_way (BR-03).

endpoints.name: Receiving list
endpoints.description: Same payload the rep sees (REQ-IN-05).

endpoints.name: Rate rep
endpoints.description: tags: fast|polite|intact|late|damaged

endpoints.name: Reserve receipt number
endpoints.description: Server-generated unique number BEFORE payment starts (REQ-IN-01). Used by EP-RP-060 then EP-RT-050.

endpoints.name: Record payment
endpoints.description: receipt_no comes from the rep app. Duplicate → 409 always (REQ-IN-01).

endpoints.name: Account summary
endpoints.description: From daily snapshots, not a live join (TB-RT-070 / BR-AD-23).

endpoints.name: Account statement
endpoints.description: Invariant: retailer.receivable == SUM(invoices) − SUM(payments) − SUM(credit_notes) (AC-07).

endpoints.name: Export statement
endpoints.description: Then poll exports; download_url lasts 24h.

endpoints.name: Debts by channel
endpoints.description: Channel name is visible here because invoices exist (after confirm).

endpoints.name: Sync pull
endpoints.description: Retailer scopes: catalog,pricing,offers,zones,orders,refs. Rep extra: rep_catalog,customers,zones,assignments,deliveries,wallet. If cursor is too old, full_resync_required=true.

endpoints.name: Sync push
endpoints.description: Max 500 ops per batch, 20/min per device. status: applied|duplicate|conflict|failed. Device never pushes catalog/prices/offers/stock (REQ-CM-017). Allowed: order, payment, delivery, receipt, shortage, favorite, rating, add-shop.

endpoints.name: Resolve sync conflict
endpoints.description: Client must not drop an op from the outbox until applied or duplicate (REQ-CM-019).

endpoints.name: Notifications inbox
endpoints.description: meta.unread_count is included in the envelope.

endpoints.name: Clear inbox view
endpoints.description: Clears the inbox view, not the server log.

endpoints.name: Home content blocks
endpoints.description: Filtered by the user activity type and zone, including intro targeting (TB-RT-010). Serving a Banner row increments impressions atomically.

endpoints.name: Record banner click
endpoints.description: Atomic clicks++ on a Banner the caller can see (covering channels). Foreign or unknown id → 404.

endpoints.name: Public intro (app splash)
endpoints.description: Same singleton the platform back office edits (EP-AD-141A/B). No auth — first-run splash before OTP. Vacant store is enabled:false. Apps must not call /platform/content/intro or /channel/content/intro (wrong_guard). Targeting is ignored on first run (no zone yet). media_id is an opaque string, not a URL, until media upload exists.

endpoints.name: Complete rep registration
endpoints.description: Channel must be active; zones must be inside its coverage (TB-RP-010). No email field — reps authenticate by Syrian mobile only.

endpoints.name: Rep catalog
endpoints.description: Union of all channels the rep belongs to. variants[] is empty when the SKU has no combinations. image is null until media is attached.

endpoints.name: Rep product detail
endpoints.description: Same isolation as the list. 404 if the product is not in the rep's channel.

endpoints.name: Shops in zone
endpoints.description: Same shop card as GET /customers. is_open is always true. last_order_at is always null. logo is always null.

endpoints.name: List customers
endpoints.description: Shops the rep sourced plus active shops in assigned zones. id is retailer_id. logo is always null. is_open is always true until a hours table exists.

endpoints.name: Register shop offline
endpoints.description: Stored locally and synced with a unique client_op_id (TB-RP-053). address, category_ids and equipment_ids are optional.

endpoints.name: Show customer
endpoints.description: 404 if the shop is not sourced by this rep and not an active shop in their zones.

endpoints.name: Request extra zone
endpoints.description: DOC-12B TB-RP-055.

endpoints.name: Rep coverage zones
endpoints.description: Assigned zones from the rep profile. Governorate name comes from GET /public/refs.

endpoints.name: Add line to shop cart
endpoints.description: Same shape as GET /cart. qty increments an existing (product, variant) line. PATCH/DELETE the line via EP-RP-025/026.

endpoints.name: Rep cart
endpoints.description: Grouped by shop. Lines include name from catalog snapshot.

endpoints.name: Submit shop order
endpoints.description: discount_percent must be ≤ the rep cap (BR-12).

endpoints.name: Rep submitted orders
endpoints.description: Sub-orders this rep submitted (rep_id is set on submit) or was later assigned. invoice_no is null until finance issues one.

endpoints.name: Update shop-cart line qty
endpoints.description: Same cart shape as GET /cart. qty 0 deletes the line (same as EP-RP-026).

endpoints.name: Remove shop-cart line
endpoints.description: Same cart shape as GET /cart. 404 if the line is not on this rep cart.

endpoints.name: Pending assignments
endpoints.description: Grouped by zone. Accept moves the card to deliveries (REQ-IN-03).

endpoints.name: Reject assignment
endpoints.description: Returns to unassigned + immediate channel alert (REQ-IN-03).

endpoints.name: On-duty toggle
endpoints.description: Tracking is enabled only while on duty (REQ-CM-054).

endpoints.name: Confirm handover
endpoints.description: Stock is deducted and status becomes on_the_way only when BOTH EP-WH-019 and this confirm exist (REQ-IN-02). temp_code used if previously offline.

endpoints.name: Adjust delivery line
endpoints.description: action: adjust|return|exchange. Updates the invoice on both sides in the same transaction (REQ-IN-05).

endpoints.name: Postpone delivery
endpoints.description: Automatically added to scheduled orders.

endpoints.name: Location pings
endpoints.description: Batched pings, on-duty only. Rate: 1/30s per rep (REQ-CM-044).

endpoints.name: Collect payment
endpoints.description: receipt_no must be reserved first via EP-CM-050. client_op_id makes retries duplicate-safe (REQ-IN-01). invoice_no is optional — omitted, the oldest open invoice for this shop and rep is allocated FIFO.

endpoints.name: Wallet
endpoints.description: net_balance == SUM(collected) − SUM(settled) at all times (AC-06).

endpoints.name: Record cash handover
endpoints.description: operation_no comes from the accountant and must stay unique across sync retries (TB-RP-063).

endpoints.name: Shop receivables
endpoints.description: Each by_shop row includes retailer_id (RetailerProfile id).

endpoints.name: Rep morning home
endpoints.description: Morning snapshot the home screen binds. Counts only — does not call GET /deliveries (that list materialises rows). avatar is always null until media upload. loyalty is the EP-APP-110 snapshot (points 0 / bronze when the wallet is empty). unread_notifications is meta.unread_count of EP-CM-060. collected_today is integer minor units. 401 without a bearer — guest browse is local, not a token.

endpoints.name: Update rep profile
endpoints.description: Name and phone only. avatar stays null until media upload. Phone must be unique among app users.

endpoints.name: Device login
endpoints.description: Device must be pre-registered. PIN is short.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 00. الدخول والتسجيل

endpoints.name: Create receiving
endpoints.description: source: purchase|transfer|field_return

endpoints.name: Start stocktake
endpoints.description: Book quantity is never shown to the counter.

endpoints.name: Approve stocktake
endpoints.description: Critical + dual + SOD-03.

endpoints.name: Warehouse queues
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Picking list
endpoints.description: Lines ordered by pick path.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Scan pick line
endpoints.description: Unknown barcode → 422 barcode_not_in_order with audio/visual warning.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Manual pick qty
endpoints.description: Flagged as manual entry.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Report pick shortage
endpoints.description: reason: out_of_stock|damaged|not_in_location. alternatives = same-category product ids (may be empty). Immediate sales alert.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Batch create picking lists
endpoints.description: Creates one picking list per sub_order via CreatesPickingList; returns existing id when already created.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Complete picking
endpoints.description: Moves to packing queue. Retailer status becomes processing.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Verify packing scans
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Complete packing
endpoints.description: flags: fragile|cold_chain
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Pending handovers
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Create handover
endpoints.description: Does NOT deduct stock or set on_the_way by itself (REQ-IN-02).
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Return trip
endpoints.description: Restocks undelivered and matches the cash bag.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Create picking wave
endpoints.description: Creates one picking list per sub_order (reuses existing), groups them into a wave for assign + print.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Show picking wave
endpoints.description: Merged multi-order pick sheet ordered by aisle/shelf like single pickingList. assign wave + print.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 07. التجهيز والعهدة

endpoints.name: Warehouse productivity report
endpoints.description: Scoped to the device warehouse. pick_accuracy_bps is integer basis points at 10^4 (1188/1200 = 9900). Empty range → zeros and empty daily[]. date_from/date_to inclusive Asia/Damascus calendar days; default last 7 days.

endpoints.name: Sort returned goods
endpoints.description: condition: resalable|damaged|expired. Warehouse decides item condition, not the requester.
endpoints.folder: 03. واجهة المستودع — أمين المستودع / 09. المرتجعات والتقييم

endpoints.name: Warehouse offline sync push
endpoints.description: Max 500 ops per batch, 20/min per device (X-Device-Id). Types: pick.scan, pick.manual, pick.shortage, pick.complete, pack.verify, pack.complete. status: applied|duplicate|conflict|failed. DomainException 409 → conflict. Permission covers pick+pack offline.

endpoints.name: Resolve warehouse sync conflict
endpoints.description: resolution: server_wins (mark discarded) | client_wins (re-apply stored payload).

endpoints.name: List stock lots
endpoints.description: warehouse_id optional — defaults to the device warehouse. Filters: product_id, expiry_before (expiry_date <=).

endpoints.name: Adjust stock lot
endpoints.description: qty_delta may be negative. Syncs on_hand via StockLedger::adjust with the same delta.

endpoints.name: Channel verify OTP
endpoints.description: Returns channel list when the user belongs to more than one.

endpoints.name: List brands
endpoints.description: Thin list. Filters: filter[status], filter[activity_type_id], filter[search] (name_ar|name_en). Default sort order.

endpoints.name: Create brand
endpoints.description: logo required (media_id from EP-SC-021); square image ≥512×512. description required ≤300. activity_type_ids required ≥1. name_ar unique per channel. status active|disabled. sliders.source ∈ algorithm|manual. banner optional media_id.

endpoints.name: Brand detail
endpoints.description: Full editor body. logo/banner are media_id strings; logo_url/banner_url are resolved. Foreign or other-channel id → 404.

endpoints.name: Update brand
endpoints.description: Same body as create. status=disabled hides the brand and its products from retailer/rep APIs without deleting channel data. sliders[] replaces the full set.

endpoints.name: Category tree
endpoints.description: Platform root categories (level 1) plus any channel-owned roots (parent_id null). description/media_id/activity_type_ids are null/[] on platform roots. image is a resolved URL; media_id is the editable id for PUT.

endpoints.name: Create category
endpoints.description: parent_id optional: omit or null to create a channel-owned root (level 1). Platform roots remain available as parents. 422 at the 6th level.

endpoints.name: Update category
endpoints.description: Does not move the node (use reorder) and does not change status (use PATCH …/status). image is a media_id string from EP-SC-021.

endpoints.name: Change category status
endpoints.description: Disable refused while the category (or any descendant) has active products or child categories — details.affected.{child_categories,active_products}. Soft disable only; no hard delete.

endpoints.name: Product detail
endpoints.description: Full create/update body for the editor. pricing may be null when unset — use PUT /products/{id}/pricing. axes/variants from generate. Non-empty barcode must be unique within the channel (product or variant). Foreign or other-channel id → 404.

endpoints.name: Create product
endpoints.description: All money fields are integer minor units (BR-AD-18). 12000 ≠ 120.00.

endpoints.name: Duplicate product
endpoints.description: Clones product children (specs/media/units/zones/activities/groups/sliders/tags/inventory flags) and product pricing. Does not copy variants — regenerate via EP-SC-017. sku required and unique.

endpoints.name: Generate variants
endpoints.description: Cartesian regenerate. Existing variants matched by SKU keep barcode/image/price_override; unmatched SKUs are deleted.

endpoints.name: Update variant
endpoints.description: price_override null clears inheritance override. Non-empty barcode unique within channel. stock+warehouse_id sets absolute on_hand for that warehouse (omit both to leave inventory untouched).

endpoints.name: Delete variant
endpoints.description: Deletes one combination without regenerating axes.

endpoints.name: Bulk product action
endpoints.description: action ∈ activate|disable|delete_draft|set_category|set_brand|set_zones|set_status. Cap 200. Price % stays EP-SC-033. payload.category_id / brand_id / zone_ids / status required per action.

endpoints.name: Import catalog
endpoints.description: Columns: sku,name_ar,name_en,barcode,brand_id,category_id,status,base_price,currency_id. Multipart only.

endpoints.name: Export catalog
endpoints.description: Async CSV with the same columns as import. Returns job_id only.

endpoints.name: Create price list
endpoints.description: type: base|zone|group|retailer. Precedence stop-at-first-match (most specific wins; lists do not stack): retailer_price ← group_list ← zone_list ← qty_tier ← base_price.

endpoints.name: Rep discount cap
endpoints.description: Exceeding cap at submit → 403 discount_cap_exceeded (BR-12).

endpoints.name: Create offer
endpoints.description: type: product_discount|invoice_discount|buy_x_get_y|bundle|tiered_discount|gift. Deleting a line in the offer removes the whole offer (BR-08).

endpoints.name: Offer detail
endpoints.description: Full create/update body for the editor. Foreign or other-channel id → 404.

endpoints.name: Update offer
endpoints.description: Same body as create minus status. Status changes only via stop/activate. Stopped/expired → 409 illegal_transition.

endpoints.name: Activate offer
endpoints.description: From stopped or draft only. Expired → 409.

endpoints.name: Offer performance
endpoints.description: conversion_rate is integer at scale 10^4 (0.22 → 2200). null when no views recorded. net_margin null when cost is unknown — never a fake 0.

endpoints.name: Create transfer
endpoints.description: Statuses: sent then received.

endpoints.name: List transfers
endpoints.description: filter[warehouse_id] matches from or to. Paginated.

endpoints.name: Inventory movements
endpoints.description: Immutable ledger with balance before/after.

endpoints.name: List sub-orders
endpoints.description: Grouped by zone with warning colors in UI.

endpoints.name: Confirm sub-order
endpoints.description: Reserves stock, creates picking list, reveals channel name to retailer.

endpoints.name: Bulk confirm
endpoints.description: Up to 50 ids. Target: 50 orders under 2 minutes.

endpoints.name: Reject sub-order
endpoints.description: Immediate retailer notification.

endpoints.name: Edit sub-order lines
endpoints.description: Mandatory retailer notification.

endpoints.name: Assign to rep
endpoints.description: mode: manual|auto|bulk_zone. auto picks the first on-duty rep covering the sub-order zone; bulk_zone assigns every confirmed/postponed sub-order in zone_id (or the first id's zone) to rep_id or that on-duty rep. 422 if no on-duty rep covers the zone (BR-19).

endpoints.name: Reassign sub-order
endpoints.description: Forbidden after handover is received.

endpoints.name: Schedule sub-order
endpoints.description: Synced to the rep calendar.

endpoints.name: Cancel sub-order
endpoints.description: Releases reservation.

endpoints.name: Weekly delivery calendar
endpoints.description: Derived from channel_zone.delivery_days. week= any date in the week (Asia/Damascus); week_start is Sunday. No new table.

endpoints.name: Channel report
endpoints.description: type ∈ sales|products|retailers|reps|zones|inventory|finance|offers|operations

endpoints.name: List return requests
endpoints.description: sla_due_at set on create from channel settings.returns_sla_hours (default 24). overdue when pending/approved and sla_due_at < now.

endpoints.name: Decide return request
endpoints.description: Financial and stock impact per BR-13. decision: approve|reject.

endpoints.name: Escalate overdue return SLA
endpoints.description: Only open+overdue return requests. Records audit and notifies channel managers via inbox/notification path.

endpoints.name: Invoice detail
endpoints.description: lines[].id is the line_id for credit-note. Foreign id → 404.

endpoints.name: Record office payment
endpoints.description: SOD-01: must not be held together with sc.orders.confirm.

endpoints.name: Settle rep wallet
endpoints.description: Invariant: wallet.net_balance == SUM(collected) − SUM(settled) (AC-06).

endpoints.name: Receivables aging
endpoints.description: group_by: zone|rep. buckets are channel totals; groups split by zone_id or rep_id.

endpoints.name: Retailer credit limit
endpoints.description: on_exceed: warn|block|manual_approval. block → 423 credit_limit_exceeded. manual_approval → queues EP-SC-165 then 423 with approval_id until approved+consumed. warn never blocks.

endpoints.name: Rep wallet (channel read)
endpoints.description: Same ledger math as GET /app/rep/wallet. Foreign channel → 404.

endpoints.name: List credit approval queue
endpoints.description: Pending rows created when on_exceed=manual_approval and confirm would exceed. status: pending|approved|rejected|consumed.

endpoints.name: Decide credit approval
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Only pending. Approve allows the next assertWithinLimit that fits the approved amount to consume the row.

endpoints.name: Banner stats
endpoints.description: ctr is integer basis points at scale 10^4 (840/12000 = 700), never a float.

endpoints.name: Create slider
endpoints.description: source: manual|brand|category|offers|algorithm. algorithm: new_arrivals|best_selling|most_ordered_by_retailer|suggested|similar|same_brand.

endpoints.name: Update reward
endpoints.description: Stopped rewards → 409.

endpoints.name: Upload media
endpoints.description: Multipart only. type ∈ image|video. Returns media_id + url for product/brand/category fields. Max image 8MB, video 50MB. Brand logos (used in EP-SC-010B/D) must be square ≥512×512 — validated on brand write.

endpoints.name: List reps
endpoints.description: id is AppUser id (same as assign / settle / discount-cap). status: pending_review|active|rejected|disabled.

endpoints.name: Rep live location
endpoints.description: Latest RepLocationPing for a rep on this channel. No ping → lat/lng/at null, on_duty still reported.

endpoints.name: Show rep
endpoints.description: Foreign channel rep → 404.

endpoints.name: Approve rep
endpoints.description: pending_review → active. reason optional. Illegal transition → 409.

endpoints.name: Reject rep
endpoints.description: pending_review → rejected. reason required.

endpoints.name: Disable rep
endpoints.description: active → disabled. reason required.

endpoints.name: Decide rep zone request
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Approve attaches zone to RepProfileZone.

endpoints.name: Decide rep-sourced shop
endpoints.description: decision: approve|reject. Approve activates RetailerProfile and marks shop linked.

endpoints.name: Job status
endpoints.description: type ∈ catalog_export|catalog_import|report_export|price_list_schedule. status ∈ queued|running|done|failed. progress 0–100. Channel-scoped; foreign job → 404.

endpoints.name: Own channel settings
endpoints.description: The authenticated channel tenant reading itself. No X-Channel-Id.

endpoints.name: Update own channel settings
endpoints.description: Partial update. status is not writable here — lifecycle stays on the platform. settings.quiet_hours {start,end,timezone} defers push/whatsapp delivery; settings.returns_sla_hours (int, default 24) sets return_requests.sla_due_at on create.

endpoints.name: Channel coverage zones
endpoints.description: Unpaginated. delivery_fee and min_order_value are decimal strings (unique money exception on this guard).

endpoints.name: Upsert coverage zone
endpoints.description: updateOrCreate on zone_id within the tenant. Optional delivery_windows: array of {day ∈ sun…sat, start/end H:i}.

endpoints.name: Remove coverage zone
endpoints.description: 204 empty body. Path param is the coverage row id (channel_zone.id), not zone_id.

endpoints.name: Zone coverage gaps
endpoints.description: Channel coverage zones with zero active reps, and zones with no default warehouse for the channel (all coverage zones when default warehouse is missing).

endpoints.name: List retailers in coverage
endpoints.description: Retailers whose zone is in this channel coverage. Id is retailer_profile id for credit/payments.

endpoints.name: Retailer 360
endpoints.description: Coverage-scoped. Foreign or out-of-coverage id → 404. credit/outstanding from finance; groups + assigned_rep_ids from identity; recent_orders/top_products/last_order_at via ordering contract. Richer fields also tracked as EP-SC-164 on this same path.

endpoints.name: List channel warehouses
endpoints.description: Unpaginated picker for inventory adjust/transfer. No create on this path.

endpoints.name: List retailer groups
endpoints.description: Channel-owned groups for price lists (type=group) and offer targeting (scope=groups).

endpoints.name: Create retailer group
endpoints.description: retailer_ids must be retailer_profile ids in this channel coverage. Empty membership allowed.

endpoints.name: Update retailer group
